messages:
kai: Heads-up — change window starts in ~2h (22:00 UTC). Planning a short freeze from 21:50 to 23:30. Target rollout: v1.12.3 (inference runtime tweaks).

oliver: Copy. Who's the rollback owner for this one?

maria: I'll take rollback. Adding myself to on-call handover.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled:
  env=prod
  version=v1.12.3
  mode=canary
  canary_pct=5
  started_at=3781239991

sre-oncall: I'm watching SLOs and 5xx. Thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms -> page. I have smoke scripts ready.

product-ops: Release notes posted: https://go.redwood/release/v1.12.3 (shortlink). Docker image pinned to sha256:abc123def456... Also note model-serving batch_size bumped to 64 in this release.

kai: Quick preflight checklist (confirm):
  - feature flag ff_release=true (confirmed)
  - db-migrate=no (no schema changes)
  - circuit-breaker=enabled (confirmed)
  - traffic-shift-policy=gradual-15m (set)

oliver: Can we enable auto-fallback to v1.12.2 if error-rate crosses threshold? deploy-bot, can you flip that?

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback rule applied:
  fallback_version=v1.12.2
  trigger=(error_rate>0.5% for 5m) OR (p95>800ms for 5m)
  action=rollback-to-fallback

maria: Rollback playbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/rollbacks/v1.12.3.md. Quick rollback commands below (copy/paste).

maria: ```
# CLI rollback (deploy system)
/deploy rollback --env prod --to v1.12.2 --confirm --reason "canary-failure"

# K8s rollback (if manual):
kubectl rollout undo deployment/ri-inference --to-revision=42 -n prod
```

kai: Reminder: freeze exemptions only for critical hotfixes. If you need an exemption open #hotfix-exempt and tag @eng-lead.

oliver: Running smoke: curl -fsS https://api.redwood.prod/health (100x) -> all OK, p95 ~120ms.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 30% (in last 8m). Current canary: 30%.

maria: Getting alerts — 5xx spike on /generate endpoint. If it doesn't stabilize within 2m I'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Alert: service=ri-inference, metric=5xx_rate, value=1.8% (>0.5%). Notifying rollback owner maria.

maria: Initiating rollback now. Executing:
/deploy rollback --env prod --to v1.12.2 --confirm --reason "canary 5xx spike"

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maria. Rolling back to v1.12.2 across prod. Estimated completion ~180s.

sre-oncall: Monitoring logs and metrics. Error rate dropping as old pods come back up. p95 latency returning to baseline.

kai: :thumbsup: Good call — keep v1.12.2 pinned until we have a root-cause. Schedule a postmortem and patch.

product-ops: Updating release notes with rollback notice and changelog entry. Posting summary to #release-notes.

maria: Signing off here — follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT to triage root cause and decide next rollout window. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: status=rollback-succeeded, final_version=v1.12.2, completed_at=3781240120
